record.category: browser and mobile device testing cloud
record.tier: Live Testing plan, with 28-day free trial

free_tier.stated: A free 28-day trial includes 60 Automated and Live Testing minutes, 3 virtual machines in parallel, and real devices and mobile emulators; the Live Testing plan is $39 a month billed annually or $49 month to month.
free_tier.notes: $39 a month divided by 730 hours is about $0.053 an hour; the plan includes one parallel test and unlimited live testing minutes. No card is required for the free trial.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a browser or device test session, not an object

retention.stated: unverified: the pricing and signup pages read state no retention period for test videos and screenshots

egress.terms: A secure local tunnel (Sauce Connect) is included on the Live Testing plan; no separate egress allowance or price is stated on the pages read.

record.interface_detail: REST API access is included on the Live Testing plan; tests run from browsers, real devices, emulators and simulators with a live view.
record.endpoint: unverified: the endpoint is not stated on the pages read
record.tooling: A user drives live tests from the browser or automates them with the REST API and Sauce Connect; higher plans add virtual and real device automation.
record.chaining: A test suite can use real devices, emulators and browser/OS combinations with a local tunnel, and collect videos and screenshots of a run.

limits.value: 60 Automated and Live Testing minutes in the 28-day free trial; the Live Testing plan has unlimited live testing minutes with 1 parallel test
1 parallel test on the base Live Testing plan; 3 virtual machines in parallel on the free trial

record.limits_note: The Virtual Device Cloud ($149/month billed annually) and Real Device Cloud ($199/month billed annually) plans add automated testing minutes and 1 to 5 concurrent sessions; Enterprise adds private device cloud and SSO.
record.binding_note: The 60 trial minutes, and then the single parallel test on the $39 plan, bind before any other limit for one user.

identity_cost.detail: Signup offers Google, GitHub or email signup and states that no credit card is required for the free account; the paid plan is charged to a card at purchase.

record.reliability_note: Secure, single-use VMs are included on the paid plans; no ban, throttle or data-loss behaviour is stated on the pages read.
record.confidence_note: Plan prices, trial minutes and signup gate are quoted from Sauce Labs' own pricing and signup pages read on 2026-11-25.
